{{Quote|Used to be I worked for Nem'ro's gang. Violent, bloody life. That's why I left. But now my little brother's following in my footsteps.|Lew Brell explains his past to an Imperial-aligned individual|<ref name="Gang" />}}
'''Lew Brell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Brell served in the [[Nem'ro's gang|gang]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]. He eventually quit the gang but was unable to make his way off-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] and ended up in the industrial [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Jiguuna]]. Sometime after Brell's resignation, his younger brother, [[Cam Brell|Cam]], decided to follow in his footsteps and began working for the Hutt. In [[3643 BBY]], Brell hired an Imperial-aligned individual to rescue his brother from a life of crime; however, Brell's efforts were in vain, as the individual returned without Cam.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You went in there, you came out, but my brother didn't. If I find out you had the chance to save his skin and you didn't&hellip;|Lew Brell|<ref name="Gang" />}}
[[File:Cam_Brell.png|thumb|left|300px|Lew Brell's brother, Cam, was imprisoned for deserting Suudaa Nem'ro's forces.]]
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Gang" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> Lew Brell lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="Gang" /> the adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Codex Hutta">{{TORcite|type=codex|Hutta}}</ref> He came to work for a Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] and became acquainted with another of Nem'ro's men named [[Rex Geer]]. Brell eventually left [[Nem'ro's gang]], however, as he began to feel the work was too violent. He then spent ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] trying to leave Nal Hutta, unsuccessfully.<ref name="Gang" />

In the year [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Brell's younger brother, [[Cam Brell|Cam]], decided to follow in his brother's footsteps and joined Nem'ro's gang. Cam ended up fighting for Nem'ro against rival Hutt [[Voontara Fa'athra]] in an industrial [[City/Legends|town]] on Nal Hutta named [[Jiguuna]],<ref name="Gang" /> which Nem'ro ruled.<ref name="CodexJiguuna">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jiguuna}}</ref> When Brell learned of his brother's choice, he attempted to rescue him from work in the gang. Brell tried to contact Rex Geer, who was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of Nem'ro's street gang, and persuade him to release Cam from service. Due the gang war raging in Jiguuna between Fa'athra and Nem'ro, Brell could not reach his old acquaintance and so began searching for an individual who could.<ref name="Gang" />

{{GameDSmechanics}}
Brell found an Imperial-aligned individual in the [[Poison Pit]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] who was willing to help him save Cam. Brell offered the individual his knowledge of Nal Hutta's gang wars in return for help but was also willing to pay in [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The individual successfully fought through Fa'athra's men and reached Geer's safe house in Jiguuna, where he and Cam were believed to be. The individual discovered that Rex had, in fact, [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] Cam within a cage, along with three other [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], as the younger Brell had attempted to flee from the battlefield during a [[Lightfight|gun fight]] and join [[Fa'athra gang|Fa'athra's side]]. Rex intended to take him before Nem'ro for questioning, and when the individual requested Cam's release, the captain offered the Imperial credits to leave Cam in his custody instead of bringing him back to Brell.<ref name="Gang" />

The individual agreed, much to Cam's horror, and left Geer's house, returning to Brell at the cantina. Upon the individual's return, Brell became angry that his brother had not been rescued and refused to pay the individual.<ref name="Gang" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I can get you experience navigating Hutta's gangs, help you build your reputation, if you help me out.|Lew Brell|<ref name="Gang" />}}
Lew Brell left Nem'ro's gang, as he considered the life too [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] and violent, although he learned a great deal about Nal Hutta's gang warfare during his work for the Hutt. When his brother, Cam, joined the same gang, he cared enough about his sibling to find an individual to help save him and was willing to offer the individual both insight into Nal Hutta's gang warfare and credits. When he learned his brother had been left to be punished by Nem'ro, Brell became angry and refused to compensate the individual who had left his brother. Brell also appreciated honesty, even from those who had done something against his wishes. Brell was bald, with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and dark skin.<ref name="Gang" />

==Equipment==
Brell wore a dark [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]] and light-colored pants while he was searching for help on Nal Hutta. He had a series of straps over the shirt and wore a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] as well.<ref name="Gang" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I can't thank you enough, kid. Here're the credits I promised&mdash;be careful on Hutta, though.|Lew Brell's dialogue if the player saves Cam|<ref name="Gang" />}}
Lew Brell first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Gang" /> His location was also marked in the accompanying ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''.<ref name="Explorers">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref> Brell is involved in the quest "Gang Warfare," in which he asks the player to rescue his brother, Cam. The player has a choice, upon finding Cam, to either leave him to his fate in exchange for credits ([[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]) or to save him ([[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]).<ref name="Gang" />

This article assumes that players choose the dark-side option and leave Cam, as only [[Imperial Agent]]s and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty Hunters]] may take this mission. If the player leaves Cam, the player, upon returning to Brell, may choose to tell him the truth about leaving Cam or claim he was already [[Death/Legends|dead]] upon arrival. Neither of these options corresponds with a specific alignment, so this article makes no assumption about which was chosen.<ref name="Gang" />
